notes: IMDwindowshopper (WWW) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its parameterless constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. Transfers are fee-free, with no owner, administrative controls or post-deployment minting. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
